checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-redact.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" redact --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Scrub secrets from stdin to stdout (canonical redactor)' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Read text on stdin, apply the canonical secret redactor' "$tmp/help"; secret="sk-ant-api03-$(printf 'A%.0s' $(seq 1 45))"; printf 'This article is about caching strategy.\ntoken: %s\n' "$secret" | "$tmp/ao" redact >"$tmp/scrubbed"; grep -Fq '[REDACTED]' "$tmp/scrubbed"; grep -Fq 'This article is about caching strategy.' "$tmp/scrubbed"; if grep -Fq "$secret" "$tmp/scrubbed"; then echo 'ao redact leaked the secret' >&2; exit 1; fi; if "$tmp/ao" redact extra-arg </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ao redact accepted a positional arg' >&2; exit 1; fi; "$tmp/ao" -o json capabilities >"$tmp/caps"; grep -Fq '"ao.redact"' "$tmp/caps"; python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); c=[x for x in d["commands"] if x.get("id")=="ao.redact"][0]; assert c["args"]=="no-args" and c["output"]=="text" and c["effects"]=="pure", c' "$tmp/caps"

aliases.reason: The redact family declares no command aliases.

stderr.reason: redact writes only the scrubbed bytes to stdout on success.

tracker_selection.reason: The redact family does not select a repository issue tracker.

ordered_effects.reason: redact is a pure deterministic transform of stdin with no ordered effects.
